pricing.basis: Standard paid-tier list price; no cache discounts, not a billing receipt

plan.decision: Report every trial and all actual usage, including recovery indexing and the retained provider failure. An interrupted continuation cannot establish the product cost claim.
plan.review: Same model, separate post-answer requests. Labels only reach the reviewer. No independent human review.
plan.scope: Frozen synthetic held-out split; Python prepare_context integration with a common host prompt, not the native ask() release gate. 80% initial ingestion, 20% append/update, then five queries per history.
plan.budget_note: Parent v2 calls and reservations remain in the active ledger. V1 and both diagnostics remain outside that ledger and are already deducted from these conservative remaining allowances. Combined ceiling remains 1,200 calls, 6 million reserved tokens and $3.
plan.operational_change: Continue only 64 RunStopped queries with no recorded model dispatch, followed by undispatched reviews. Carry forward every parent call and unchanged completed answer; keep the real HTTP 429 query failure in its denominator. Ten-second spacing, one concurrent call. Rebuild temporary databases for unfinished histories; charge repeated indexing to tree application usage. No prompt, retrieval, fixture, scoring, or model changes.
